The '''Krann system''' was in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Krann system was introduced in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], which placed it on the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]]. The sourcebook also introduced the [[planet]] [[Krann]] of the same name, but placed it in the [[Opiteihr system/Legends|Opiteihr system]] instead.
